title: Предварительный обзор — 10 ноября 2026 г.
intro:
Crude oil is under notable selling pressure today, with WTI dropping 2.30% to 84.85 and Brent declining 2.73% to 90.04. The downward move in energy reflects broader macroeconomic caution and shifting supply-demand expectations.
Market theme
Risk appetite remains selective as Treasury yields edge higher, with the US 10-year rising 0.5bp to 4.864% and the DXY strengthening to 101.77. Sector rotation is evident as chipmakers experience sharp idiosyncratic moves alongside broader tech weakness.
Potential scenario
Potential scenario: Our base case anticipates choppy consolidation around the S&P 500 level of 7,576.50 as markets await the October CPI print. Alternatively, a sharp inflation surprise could trigger downside pressure toward the Nasdaq 100 level of 27,898.
Key risks
• Higher than expected October CPI print triggering rate hike fears following Waller hawkish comments
• Continued downside momentum in major semiconductor names like Nvidia impacting broader tech sentiment
